title: Slide
description: One idea on one screen. On a page: <pd-components-slide eyebrow="…" heading="…">text</pd-components-slide>.

eyebrow.description: A short line above the headline: where the slide sits in the story

heading.description: The slide's one idea, as its headline

text.description: The slide's content: the tag's content, as markdown

anchor.description: An id for the slide's headline, so a link can point at it (as the cover's link to the first slide does)
